summary: Calculate the fee for an open parking ticket
user_story: As a cashier, I want the system to calculate the parking charge so that the driver pays the correct amount.
description: Calculate the amount due from entry time to calculation time using the configured grace period, rounded-up hourly charge, and daily cap.
acceptance_criteria: Parking within the grace period costs zero.
Every started hour after the grace period is charged as a full hour.
The charge for each 24-hour period does not exceed the daily cap.
The quote contains duration, amount, currency, and pricing-rule version.
Unknown and CLOSED tickets are rejected.
